Word reaches you, days late: Catarina stands accused over what happened to Popon. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.

The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.

◈ FLASHBACK — Hoodie
Dorm laundry and rain. The night the storm took the power you walked three miles home in this, soaked through, laughing. Armor, basically.

◈ FLASHBACK — Wedding Ring
Gold band, worn thin. Inside: initials and a date. You remember the day — the rain, the borrowed suit, the laughter during the vows. Grief is just love with nowhere to go.

◈ FLASHBACK — Knife roll
The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize.

◈ FLASHBACK — Photo Album
Faces from before. Shu's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
Catarina looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
